summary: Iteration 65: Order Flow / Institutional Wall Detection Testing Complete. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. The new Order Flow system correctly analyzes intraday volume profiles to detect institutional walls (3x+ median volume). API endpoints return volume profiles with walls, POC, and institutional bias. Frontend OrderFlowPanel renders correctly with ticker selector, bias badges, and volume bars.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 65 verified the Order Flow / Institutional Wall Detection system. Key findings: (1) GET /api/order-flow/{symbol} returns volume profile with walls, summary, POC, and institutional bias, (2) Crypto tickers (BTC, ETH) auto-convert to -USD format, (3) Wall detection uses 3x median threshold (minor) and 5x for major walls, (4) Institutional bias: INSTITUTIONAL_BID (>65% support volume), INSTITUTIONAL_ASK (<35%), BALANCED otherwise, (5) All 3 AI crews (war_room, hypothesis, prediction) inject order_flow_context into synthesizer prompts, (6) Frontend OrderFlowPanel has data-testid attributes: order-flow-panel, order-flow-toggle, flow-ticker-{SPY|AAPL|TSLA|NVDA|MSFT|BTC|ETH}, flow-refresh, wall-list, (7) Volume bars show price, volume (in M), ratio (Nx), and strength badge (M=major, m=minor), (8) Bias badge shows 'Institutional Buying' (green), 'Institutional Selling' (red), or 'Balanced Flow' (gray).
